sentences.japanese: 医者は、私の胃を調べるためにＸ線を用いた。
sentences.english: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.

sentences.japanese: ん～、イマイチなんだよねえ。この脚のあたりの線とかさぁ。なんとかなんないの？
sentences.english: This drawing is less than great. He needs to do something with the line here at the back of the leg.

sentences.japanese: そもそも何故私の物だけ液晶に線が入っていたのか。
sentences.english: In any case why was it only mine that had a line in the LCD?

sentences.japanese: その２つの線は直角に交わっている。
sentences.english: The two lines cross each other at right angles.

sentences.japanese: 地図上の太い線は道路に相当する。
sentences.english: The broad lines on the map correspond to roads.
